AR>EN|لحق.plain_meaning: to catch up; to make it in time

examples.translation: He caught the metro before it left.
I won't make it to work on time today.

AR>EN|جهز.definition: to make something ready for use or an event

examples.translation: Prepare the bag the night before.

AR>EN|ظبط.plain_meaning: to fix; to set; to adjust (Egyptian)
AR>EN|ظبط.definition: to fix, adjust, or arrange something; also to book or set up an appointment

examples.translation: I'll set you an appointment with the doctor.

AR>EN|دفع.definition: to give money for something; also to push

examples.translation: He paid the bill in cash.
He pushed the door and went in.

AR>EN|صرف.definition: to use money to buy things; to pay out

examples.sentence: صرف كل مرتبه في أول الأسبوع.
examples.translation: He spent his whole salary in the first week.

examples.sentence: ما تصرفش فلوسك على حاجات ملهاش لازمة.
examples.translation: Don't spend your money on useless things.

AR>EN|اقترض.plain_meaning: to borrow; to take a loan
AR>EN|اقترض.definition: to take money from someone or a bank that you must give back

examples.translation: He borrowed from the bank for the apartment.
She doesn't like to borrow from anyone.

AR>EN|سلف.definition: to give someone money that they will pay back later

examples.translation: Can you lend me a hundred pounds?

examples.sentence: سلف صاحبه الفلوس لحد آخر الشهر.
examples.translation: He lent his friend the money until the end of the month.

AR>EN|فكر.definition: to use your mind to consider something; also means 'he thought' as past tense

AR>EN|قرر.definition: to make a decision after thinking

examples.translation: They decided to get married next year.

AR>EN|حاول.definition: to make an effort to do something

examples.translation: Try again, you can do it.
She's trying to understand the difference.

AR>EN|قدر.plain_meaning: to be able to; to manage
AR>EN|قدر.definition: to have the ability or possibility to do something

examples.translation: He managed to finish the work in a day.

AR>EN|قعد.definition: to sit down; also means to stay somewhere or to spend time

examples.translation: We sat at the cafe for two hours.

AR>EN|صحي.definition: to stop sleeping; to become awake

examples.translation: I woke up early in the morning.

AR>EN|فتح.definition: to make something open; to start a business or event

examples.translation: He opened a new shop on the street.

AR>EN|صلح.definition: to repair something broken so it works again

examples.translation: I'll fix the fan this summer.

AR>EN|غسل.definition: to clean something with water and usually soap

examples.translation: He washed his hands before eating.
She washed the clothes in the machine.

AR>EN|كوي.definition: to press clothes with a hot iron to remove wrinkles

examples.translation: He ironed the suit for the wedding.

AR>EN|نظف.definition: to make a place or thing free from dirt

examples.translation: She cleaned the room in the morning.
Clean the filter before running it.

AR>EN|كنس.definition: to clean a floor with a broom

examples.translation: He swept the balcony free of dust.
She swept the floor before laying the carpet.

AR>EN|مسح.definition: to clean a surface with a cloth or mop; also to erase data

examples.translation: He wiped the dust off the table.
He deleted all the photos from the phone.

AR>EN|مسك.definition: to take and keep something in your hand; also to catch

examples.translation: He held the phone and answered.
He caught the ball with one hand.

AR>EN|وقع.definition: to drop down; to fall over; also means 'he signed' (وقّع) in formal contexts but commonly 'fell'

examples.translation: He fell on the stairs and got hurt.

AR>EN|رفع.definition: to move something to a higher position

examples.translation: He lifted the bag onto the shelf.
He raised his hand to ask.

AR>EN|رجع.plain_meaning: to return; to come back; to give back
AR>EN|رجع.definition: to go back to a place; also to give something back

examples.translation: He came back from work late.
He'll return the money next week.

AR>EN|جا.definition: the past tense of 'to come' in Egyptian Arabic; present is بيجي

AR>EN|قال.definition: the past tense of 'to say'; also used in the expression 'قال إيه' (what did he say)

examples.translation: He told me he'll be late.
What did he say? I didn't hear him.

AR>EN|قرا.definition: the past tense of 'to read' in Egyptian Arabic; present is بيقرا

examples.translation: He read the book in a week.
He read the news in the paper.

AR>EN|كتب.definition: the past tense of 'to write'; present is بيكتب

examples.translation: He wrote the letter and sent it.
He wrote his name on the paper.

AR>EN|ذاكر.definition: to study or review school or university material

examples.translation: I'm studying for the exam all night.

AR>EN|اشتغل.definition: to do a job; also means a device 'worked' or 'ran'

AR>EN|ارتاح.definition: to take a break and relax; also to feel comfortable

examples.translation: He rested a bit after lunch.
He settled into the new job.

AR>EN|ساعد.definition: to make something easier for someone; to give support

examples.translation: He helped me with the work.

AR>EN|قابل.definition: to see and talk with someone, by plan or by chance

examples.translation: I met my friend at the club.
I'll meet you tomorrow at work.

AR>EN|عرف.plain_meaning: to know; to find out; he knew
AR>EN|عرف.definition: to know a fact or person; also the past tense 'he knew/found out'

examples.translation: He learned the news from a newspaper.

AR>EN|لعب.definition: to play a game or sport; also past tense 'he played'

examples.translation: He played football with his friends.
The kids are playing in the garden.

AR>EN|عمل.plain_meaning: to do; to make; he did
AR>EN|عمل.definition: to do or make something; past tense 'he did/made'

examples.translation: She made all the food by herself.

AR>EN|مات.definition: the past tense of 'to die'; present is بيموت

examples.translation: His grandfather died two years ago.

AR>EN|اتولد.definition: the past tense of 'to be born'

examples.translation: Their son was born last week.

AR>EN|كبر.plain_meaning: to grow up; to get older; to grow bigger
AR>EN|كبر.definition: to become older or bigger; past tense 'he grew up'

examples.translation: He grew up in a working-class neighborhood.

AR>EN|اتجوز.definition: to marry someone; past tense 'he got married'

AR>EN|طلق.definition: to legally end a marriage; past tense 'he divorced'

examples.translation: He divorced his wife a year ago.
They divorced after five years of marriage.

AR>EN|اختار.definition: to pick one option from several

AR>EN|غير.definition: to make or become different; to replace something

examples.translation: He changed his mind in the end.
She changed the look of the room.

AR>EN|بدل.plain_meaning: to exchange; to change clothes; to swap
AR>EN|بدل.definition: to swap one thing for another; also to change clothes

examples.translation: He exchanged the money at the exchange office.
He changed his clothes after work.

AR>EN|جرب.plain_meaning: to try; to test; to experience
AR>EN|جرب.definition: to test or try something to see how it is

AR>EN|ضحك.definition: to make sounds showing amusement; past tense 'he laughed'

examples.translation: They laughed a lot at the gathering.

AR>EN|عيط.definition: to shed tears from sadness or pain; past tense 'he cried'

examples.translation: She cried when she heard the news.

AR>EN|ابتسم.definition: to form a smile with your mouth

examples.translation: He smiled when he saw her.

AR>EN|سكت.plain_meaning: to be quiet; he went silent
AR>EN|سكت.definition: to stop talking or making noise; past tense 'he was quiet'

examples.translation: Be quiet a bit, I want to hear.

AR>EN|همس.definition: to speak very softly so others cannot hear

examples.translation: He whispered sweet words in her ear.

AR>EN|رقص.definition: to move your body to music; past tense 'he danced'

examples.translation: They danced all night at the wedding.

AR>EN|نط.definition: to push yourself up off the ground; past tense 'he jumped'

examples.translation: The cat jumped onto the table.

AR>EN|جري.definition: to move fast on foot; past tense 'he ran'

examples.translation: He runs every morning at the club.

AR>EN|مشي.plain_meaning: to walk; he walked; to leave
AR>EN|مشي.definition: to move on foot; also means 'he left' (مشي من هنا)

examples.translation: He walked on foot all the way home.

AR>EN|وقف.plain_meaning: to stop; to stand; he stood
AR>EN|وقف.definition: to stand up, or to stop moving or working

AR>EN|ركب.plain_meaning: to ride; to get on; he rode
AR>EN|ركب.definition: to get on or into a vehicle or animal; past tense 'he rode/got on'

examples.translation: He took the metro from Ramses.
He got on his bike and left.

AR>EN|ساق.definition: to control and move a vehicle; past tense 'he drove'

examples.translation: He drove the car all the way to Alexandria.

AR>EN|سرق.definition: to take something that doesn't belong to you; past tense 'he stole'

examples.translation: He stole the phone from the bag.
His wallet was stolen in the crowd.

AR>EN|غش.definition: to act dishonestly to win or pass; past tense 'he cheated'

examples.translation: He cheated on the exam and got caught.
The merchant cheated on the scale.

AR>EN|نصب.definition: to trick someone out of money; past tense 'he scammed'

examples.translation: He scammed people and took their money.
He got scammed when buying the apartment.

AR>EN|ضرب.definition: to strike someone or something; past tense 'he hit'

examples.translation: He hit him on the back by mistake.

AR>EN|شتم.definition: to say rude or offensive words to someone

examples.translation: He cursed him in front of people.

AR>EN|هرب.plain_meaning: to run away; to escape; he fled
AR>EN|هرب.definition: to leave quickly to avoid danger or a bad situation

examples.translation: He ran away from home at night.

examples.sentence: الحرامي هرب قبل ما البوليس ييجي.
examples.translation: The thief fled before the police came.

AR>EN|كسب.plain_meaning: to win; to earn; he won
AR>EN|كسب.definition: to win a game or prize, or to earn money

examples.translation: He won the match by two goals.
He earned a lot of money from the project.

AR>EN|خسر.definition: to fail to win, or to no longer have something

examples.translation: He lost the match in the end.
He lost a lot of money in the stock market.

AR>EN|سمع.plain_meaning: to hear; to listen; he heard
AR>EN|سمع.definition: to perceive sound; also used for 'listen' and 'hear about'

AR>EN|شم.definition: to sense a smell with your nose

examples.translation: He smelled the food from the street.
Smell this flower, it smells nice.

AR>EN|ذاق.definition: to try food or drink to know its flavor; also 'to experience'

examples.translation: He tasted the food before serving it.
He tasted the bitterness of living abroad.

AR>EN|فرغ.definition: to remove everything from a container or place

examples.translation: He emptied the trash in the morning.
He emptied the bag onto the bed.

AR>EN|خبي.definition: to put something where it can't be seen; past tense 'he hid'

examples.translation: He hid the money under the mattress.
He hid the truth from his family.

AR>EN|علي قده.definition: describes something modest that fits your budget or ability, not fancy

examples.translation: Live within your means and don't overspend.
He had a modest wedding within his means.

idiom.meaning: modest; within one's means (Egyptian idiom)
examples: عيش على قدك ومتتكلفش.
Live within your means and don't overspend.

AR>EN|حيلو.definition: an informal word for nice, pretty, or sweet, heard in Upper Egypt and Sudan

AR>EN|مسخ.definition: describes something disgusting, nasty, or in very bad shape

examples.translation: This food is disgusting, don't eat it.
The street is filthy after the rain.

AR>EN|بايز.definition: describes spoiled food, a broken thing, or a worthless situation

examples.translation: The meat is spoiled, throw it away.
The whole plan is no good.

AR>EN|سليم.definition: in good condition, correct, or healthy

examples.translation: The car is sound, nothing wrong with it.

examples.sentence: الحمد لله، طلع سليم من الحادثة.
examples.translation: Thank God, he came out of the accident unharmed.

AR>EN|عطلان.definition: describes a machine or device that isn't working

examples.translation: The washing machine has been broken for a week.
The AC is broken in this heat.

AR>EN|بايظ.definition: describes something very bad, corrupt, or a person with a bad character

examples.sentence: ده راجل بايظ، ما تتعاملش معاه.
examples.translation: He's a bad man, don't deal with him.

AR>EN|موفق.definition: blessed with success in what you do

examples.translation: May God keep you successful always.
He was fortunate in choosing his career.

AR>EN|منحوس.definition: someone who always has bad luck

examples.translation: An unlucky day from the start.

AR>EN|فهلوي.definition: someone clever in a practical, sometimes sneaky way; a smooth operator

examples.sentence: هو فهلوي وبيلاقي حل لكل حاجة.
examples.translation: He's street-smart and finds a solution for everything.

examples.sentence: ما تبقاش فهلوي في الحاجات دي.
examples.translation: Don't be crafty about these things.
He's a bit slow to understand.

AR>EN|عبيط.definition: foolish or silly in a light, sometimes playful way

examples.sentence: ما تبقاش عبيط وتصدق الكلام ده.
examples.translation: Don't be silly and believe that.
He did a silly move in front of everyone.

AR>EN|جدع.definition: describes a man who is decent, brave, and helps others without being asked

examples.translation: He's a stand-up guy, always there for us.
Being a good guy isn't just talk.

AR>EN|اصيل.definition: genuine and true to its roots, whether a person, food, or tradition

examples.translation: He comes from a good family.

AR>EN|زفت.definition: slang for something worthless or of very bad quality

examples.sentence: الفيلم ده زفت، ما تتفرجش عليه.
examples.translation: This movie is junk, don't watch it.

AR>EN|عال العال.definition: means something is of the highest quality or condition

examples.sentence: كل حاجة عال العال والحمد لله.
examples.translation: Everything is top notch, thank God.

idiom.meaning: top notch; A-plus (Egyptian idiom)
examples: العربية عال العال.
The car is top notch.

AR>EN|خراب.definition: describes something ruined, wrecked, or falling apart

examples.translation: The house became a wreck after the fire.
The project was doomed from the start.

AR>EN|مضروب.definition: describes counterfeit money, fake products, or fixed results

AR>EN|اصلي.definition: real and not a copy; genuine

examples.translation: This is an original perfume, not an imitation.
The painting is genuine from the Pharaonic era.

AR>EN|تقليد.definition: a copy made to look like the original, usually cheaper and lower quality

examples.translation: This watch is an imitation, not original.

examples.sentence: تقليد درجة أولى شكله قريب من الأصلي.
examples.translation: A first-grade knockoff looks close to the original.

AR>EN|مليحة.definition: means good or fine, common in Upper Egypt and older speech

examples.translation: That's a good thing, God bless.

AR>EN|زريبة.plain_meaning: a dump; a filthy place (Egyptian slang)
AR>EN|زريبة.definition: slang for a filthy, messy, or awful place; literally an animal pen

examples.translation: The room is a dump, clean it.
The office is a dump from the dust.

AR>EN|عظمة.definition: means greatness; as slang, an exclamation meaning 'wow, how great'

AR>EN|فشيخ.definition: slang for something high-end, fancy, or done perfectly

examples.translation: The car is top-class, very fancy.
He did top-class work on the design.

AR>EN|خطير.definition: literally 'dangerous'; as slang it means impressively good or skilled

examples.translation: This road is dangerous at night.

examples.sentence: هو لاعب خطير، محدش يقدر عليه.
examples.translation: He's a brilliant player, no one can stop him.

AR>EN|نار.definition: literally 'fire'; as slang it means something is amazing or intense

AR>EN|سريع.definition: moving or happening at high speed

AR>EN|بطيء.definition: moving or happening at low speed

examples.translation: The traffic is very slow in the morning.

AR>EN|ثقيل.definition: having a lot of weight; also used for a boring or annoying person (دمه تقيل)

examples.translation: The bag is heavy, help me.
This food is heavy on the stomach.

AR>EN|خفيف.definition: having little weight; also means funny and likeable (دمه خفيف)

examples.translation: The bag is light, I'll carry it myself.
He's fun to be around, everyone loves him.

AR>EN|واسع.definition: having a large distance from side to side; roomy

examples.translation: The street is wide and clean.
The room is spacious enough for a family.

AR>EN|ضيق.definition: having a small distance from side to side; tight

examples.translation: The alley is narrow, the car won't pass.
The pants are tight on me.

AR>EN|طويل.definition: great in height for people or buildings; long for objects and time

examples.translation: He's tall, taller than his dad.
The road is long to Alexandria.

AR>EN|قصير.definition: small in height or length; brief in time

examples.translation: The film is short, only half an hour.

AR>EN|عالي.definition: high in position, level, or price; for sound it means loud

examples.translation: Lower your voice, it's too loud.

AR>EN|واطي.definition: low in position, level, or volume

examples.translation: Prices are low in this market.
The house is far from work.
That matter is none of your business.

AR>EN|قريب.definition: at a short distance; also means a close relative

examples.translation: He's my relative on my mother's side.

AR>EN|مليان.definition: completely filled; also means very busy

examples.translation: The bus is full, wait for the next one.

AR>EN|مفتوح.definition: not closed or locked; available for business

examples.translation: The shop is open until midnight.

AR>EN|مقفول.definition: closed or locked; not open for business

examples.translation: The shop is closed on Friday.
The door is locked with the key.

AR>EN|شغال.definition: describes a device that works, or a person who has a job

examples.translation: He works at a big company.

AR>EN|مكسور.definition: damaged into pieces or no longer working

examples.translation: His leg was broken after the accident.

AR>EN|متصلح.definition: describes something that has been repaired after being broken

examples.translation: The phone is repaired and working again.
The car is fixed from the workshop.
He's a handsome and polite young man.
This actor is handsome and famous.

AR>EN|انيق.definition: stylish and graceful in appearance or behavior

examples.translation: The restaurant is elegant and quiet.
This shop is chic and expensive.
His car is fancy and expensive.

AR>EN|بسيط.definition: easy to understand or do; not complicated or fancy

examples.translation: The recipe is simple and easy.

AR>EN|معقد.definition: difficult to understand because of many connected parts

examples.translation: The problem is a bit complicated.
This restaurant is known for its koshari.
He's a well-known figure in the neighborhood.

AR>EN|غامض.definition: difficult to understand or explain; unclear

examples.translation: The story is mysterious and exciting.
His answer was vague and unclear.

AR>EN|واضح.definition: easy to see, hear, or understand; obvious

examples.translation: It's obvious he doesn't want to come.

AR>EN|مخفي.definition: kept out of sight or not obvious

examples.translation: There's a hidden message in the movie.

AR>EN|ظاهر.definition: easy to see or notice; as an expression it means 'it seems'

examples.translation: It seems it's going to rain.
The improvement is apparent in his work.

AR>EN|عميق.definition: going far down or in; also for strong feelings or thoughts

examples.translation: His words are deep and need thinking.

AR>EN|ضحل.definition: not deep, for water or for thinking

examples.sentence: المية هنا ضحلة، ممكن تمشي فيها.
examples.translation: The water here is shallow, you can walk in it.
His thinking is shallow, not deep.

AR>EN|حاد.definition: having a fine cutting edge, or intense and harsh for pain or words

examples.translation: The knife is sharp, watch your hand.
The pain is sharp in my back.

AR>EN|كليل.definition: not sharp, for blades; also for slow minds or weak pain

examples.translation: The knife is dull and doesn't cut.
A dull pain in my back.

AR>EN|ناعم.definition: smooth and gentle to the touch; also for gentle manners

examples.translation: Her voice is soft and calm.

AR>EN|خشن.definition: having an uneven, harsh surface; also for harsh behavior

examples.translation: His hand is rough from work.
This fabric is rough on the skin.

AR>EN|ضخم.definition: extremely large in size, amount, or importance

examples.sentence: المول ده ضخم، فيه كل حاجة.
examples.translation: This mall is huge, it has everything.
The project is massive and will take years.

AR>EN|هايل.definition: extraordinarily large in size or degree

examples.translation: The party was an enormous success.
He lost an enormous sum in the deal.

AR>EN|تافه.definition: having little value or importance; silly

examples.sentence: ما تضيعش وقتك في حاجات تافهة.
examples.translation: Don't waste your time on trivial things.
The fight was over a trivial reason.

AR>EN|ثمين.definition: worth a lot of money or very precious

examples.translation: Time is precious, don't waste it.
This bird is rare in Egypt.
An opportunity like this is rare.

AR>EN|منتشر.definition: found or happening in many places; common

examples.translation: The illness is widespread in winter.
This habit is common in Egypt.
This name is common in Upper Egypt.

AR>EN|خاص.definition: belonging to one person or group, not public; also means special

examples.translation: This is a private number, don't give it to anyone.

AR>EN|عام.definition: relating to everyone; open to all people

examples.translation: That's general knowledge, everyone knows it.

AR>EN|رسمي.definition: approved or done by an authority; formal

examples.translation: The official contract was signed today.
Formal dress is required at the event.

AR>EN|شخصي.definition: relating to one particular person, not shared

examples.translation: This file is secret, copying is forbidden.
The recipe has been secret for ages.

AR>EN|علني.definition: done or said openly for everyone to know

examples.translation: The meeting was public and open to the press.

AR>EN|دايم.definition: lasting for a long time or forever; not temporary

examples.translation: He finally found a permanent job.
The housing is permanent, not temporary.

AR>EN|موقت.definition: lasting for a limited time only; not permanent

examples.sentence: الشغل ده مؤقت لحد ما يلاقي أحسن.
examples.translation: This job is temporary until he finds better.

examples.sentence: الحل ده مؤقت، المشكلة لسه موجودة.
examples.translation: This solution is temporary; the problem still exists.

AR>EN|حقيقي.definition: actually existing or true; not fake or imaginary

examples.translation: This story is real, it actually happened.
This gold is real, not plated.

AR>EN|وهمي.definition: existing only in the imagination; not real

examples.translation: This fear is imaginary, there's no danger.
The company is fake and scammed people.

AR>EN|مباشر.definition: going straight without stops or intermediaries; also means live on air

examples.translation: There's a direct flight to Luxor.

AR>EN|حلو.definition: tasting of sugar; also very common for 'nice', 'good', or 'beautiful'

examples.translation: The tea is sweet, did you put too much sugar?

AR>EN|عسل.definition: the sweet food made by bees; as slang, calling someone عسل means they're sweet or wonderful

examples.translation: That girl is a sweetheart, kind and respectful.

AR>EN|بشع.definition: very ugly or very bad in quality or behavior

examples.translation: The scene was hideous after the accident.

AR>EN|قبيح.definition: unpleasant to look at; also for bad behavior

examples.translation: The house is old and ugly from outside.

AR>EN|دافي.definition: comfortably warm, for weather, water, or clothes

examples.translation: The weather is warm in spring.

AR>EN|معتدل.definition: neither too much nor too little; mild for weather

examples.translation: The weather is mild in October.
His views are moderate, not extreme.

AR>EN|منعش.definition: making you feel fresh, cool, and full of energy

examples.translation: Iced water is refreshing in the heat.
The breeze is refreshing by the sea.

AR>EN|ناشف.definition: without moisture; dried out, for food, land, or humor

examples.translation: The food is dry, there's no sauce.
The land is dry from lack of rain.

AR>EN|مبلول.definition: covered or filled with water or another liquid

examples.translation: His clothes are wet from the rain.
The floor is wet, careful not to slip.

AR>EN|طري.definition: soft and easy to cut or chew, for meat and bread

examples.translation: The meat is tender and easy to eat.
The bread is soft and still warm.

AR>EN|صلب.definition: firm and difficult to cut or bend; also tough in character

examples.translation: The walnut is hard, it needs a hammer.
He's a tough man in his decisions.

AR>EN|مرن.definition: able to bend easily, or willing to adapt

examples.translation: His body is flexible from yoga.
The company is flexible about working hours.
Glass is fragile, be careful carrying it.
His health is fragile after the operation.

AR>EN|مضيء.definition: giving off lots of light; well-lit

examples.translation: The room is bright from the sun.
The street is dark at night.
The room is dark and the light is off.

AR>EN|مالح.definition: tasting of or containing a lot of salt

AR>EN|حار.definition: containing strong hot spices like chili; for weather it means hot

AR>EN|مر.definition: having a sharp, unpleasant taste like black coffee; also for painful experiences

examples.translation: The coffee is bitter without sugar.
He went through a bitter experience.

AR>EN|حامض.definition: having a sharp acidic taste like lemon

examples.translation: The yogurt tastes a bit sour.

AR>EN|طازة.definition: newly made, picked, or caught; not old or frozen

examples.translation: The vegetables are fresh from the market.
The bread is fresh from the bakery.

AR>EN|بايت.definition: describes food left from the day before; not fresh

examples.translation: The bread is stale, get fresh.

AR>EN|منتهي الصلاحية.definition: past the date after which a product should not be used or eaten

examples.translation: The milk is expired, throw it away.

examples.sentence: بص على تاريخ الصلاحية قبل ما تشتري.
examples.translation: Check the expiry date before you buy.

AR>EN|ساري.definition: still legally or officially acceptable; in effect

examples.translation: The visa is valid for a year.
The offer is valid until the end of the month.

AR>EN|عكس.definition: the reverse or contrary of something; also a preposition 'against'

examples.translation: He does the opposite of what he says.
The house is opposite the station.
